data.value: Will the Herrera cousins, trading messages in a fourteen-person group chat, fix a weekend and a town for next spring's family reunion before the end of September?

The Herrera cousins have an active group chat that has been running for a month. The chat includes all 14 cousins. The topic of the next spring's family reunion has been discussed, with three cousins advocating for Oaxaca, two for San Antonio, and Tia Marisol frequently changing the subject to catering. No decision on weekend or town has been made yet.
